Enterprise technology executive with 20+ years of experience leading large-scale platform modernization, data and AI strategy, and post-M&A integration across financial services and fintech organizations.

 Consolidating complex technology landscapes following acquisitions
 Modernizing legacy platforms into scalable, cloud-enabled ecosystems
